player_prompt.intro:
Kedda d-iklan {player_id} deg wari n Tic Tac Toe n uhawi. Asaru d-ik ' {symbol} '.
Tawala d-ik tga t-idir tirga t-kel maden (s-ufella, s-ukessa, neɣ s-azelmaḍ).
Ma t-ekkes tirga t-kel maden, t-ikkes.
Sekked t-idir t-imuz deg wari n '[4]' akken ad teskar asaru d-ik deg tazrart 4.
Akka d-iklan {player_id}, d-ik ' {symbol} ' ɣas d-iklan nniḍen ' {opponent_symbol} '.
